definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."ControllingArea","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."ValidityEndDate","d"."ProfitCtrResponsiblePersonName","d"."CompanyCode","d"."ProfitCtrResponsibleUser","d"."ValidityStartDate","d"."Department","d"."ProfitCenterStandardHierarchy","d"."Segment","d"."ProfitCenterIsBlocked","d"."FormulaPlanningTemplate","d"."FormOfAddress","d"."AddressName","d"."AdditionalName","d"."ProfitCenterAddrName3","d"."ProfitCenterAddrName4","d"."StreetAddressName","d"."POBox","d"."CityName","d"."PostalCode","d"."POBoxPostalCode","d"."District","d"."Country","d"."Region","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."Language","d"."PhoneNumber1","d"."PhoneNumber2","d"."TeleboxNumber","d"."TelexNumber","d"."FaxNumber","d"."TeletexNumber","d"."DataCommunicationPhoneNumber","d"."ProfitCenterPrinterName","d"."ProfitCenterCreatedByUser","d"."ProfitCenterCreationDate","d"."LogicalSystem"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_PROFITCENTER_S4_CURR" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_PROFITCENTER'
